func TestClientGetsLearningActionContextWithInternalToken(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	actionID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodGet, r.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/students/"+studentID+"/learning-actions/"+actionID+"/context", r.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "internal-token", r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{
			"learning_action_id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			"student_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
			"task_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
			"context_type":"lesson_task",
			"context_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
			"learning_targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.errors","version":"v1"}],
			"status":"OPEN",
			"opened_at":"2026-08-30T10:00:00Z"
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	got, err := client.GetLearningActionContext(context.Background(), studentID, actionID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, actionID, got.LearningActionID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LearningActionStatusOpen, got.Status)
	require.Equal(t, "go.errors", got.LearningTargets[0].Key)
}

func TestClientGetsBoundedLearningActionCodeContext(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	actionID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	taskID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodGet, r.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/students/"+studentID+"/learning-actions/"+actionID+"/code-context", r.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "internal-token", r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{
			"learning_action_id":"` + actionID + `","student_id":"` + studentID + `","task_id":"` + taskID + `",
			"available":true,"files":[{"path":"main.go","content":"package main","truncated":false}],
			"omitted_file_count":0,"truncated":false,"policy_version":"student-learning-action-code-context-v1",
			"validation":{"available":false,"kind":"","passed":false,"issue_count":0,"policy_version":"sandbox-validation-observation-v1"}
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	got, err := client.GetLearningActionCodeContext(context.Background(), studentID, actionID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, got.Available)
	require.Equal(t, taskID, got.TaskID)
	require.Equal(t, "main.go", got.Files[0].Path)
	require.False(t, got.Validation.Available)
}

func TestClientQueriesOrderedTargetMastery(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	targets := []domain.LearningTargetRef{
		{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors"},
		{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap", Version: "v1"},
	}
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodPost, r.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/students/"+studentID+"/mastery/query", r.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "application/json", r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
		var body struct {
			Targets []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"targets"`
		}
		require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body))
		require.Equal(t, targets, body.Targets)
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"items":[
			{"target":{"type":"concept","key":"go.errors"},"state":"APPLIED","mastery_score":1,"confidence":0.33333,"independent_success_count":1,"assisted_success_count":0,"failure_count":0,"evidence_count":1,"last_seen_at":"2026-08-30T10:00:00Z","last_practiced_at":"2026-08-30T10:00:00Z","policy_version":"student-mastery-v1"},
			{"target":{"type":"capability","key":"go.errors.wrap","version":"v1"},"state":"UNKNOWN","mastery_score":0,"confidence":0,"independent_success_count":0,"assisted_success_count":0,"failure_count":0,"evidence_count":0,"policy_version":"student-mastery-v1"}
		]}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	got, err := client.GetTargetMastery(context.Background(), studentID, targets)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Len(t, got, 2)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TargetMasteryApplied, got[0].State)
	require.NotNil(t, got[0].LastSeenAt)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TargetMasteryUnknown, got[1].State)
}

func TestClientGetsBoundedLearnerOverview(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodGet, r.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/students/"+studentID+"/learner-overview", r.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "internal-token", r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{
			"student_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
			"version":"student-learner-overview-v2",
			"onboarding":{"student_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","direction_code":"backend","self_assessed_experience":"basic","known_stacks":[],"desired_stacks":["go"],"goal_code":"first-job","preferred_language":"ru","weekly_minutes":300,"preferred_pace":"balanced","profile_version":"student-onboarding-v1","version":1,"created_at":"2026-08-31T08:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-08-31T08:00:00Z"},
			"recent_mastery":[{"student_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","target":{"type":"concept","key":"go.interfaces"},"state":"PRACTICED","mastery_score":0,"confidence":0.33333,"independent_success_count":0,"assisted_success_count":0,"failure_count":1,"evidence_count":1,"last_seen_at":"2026-08-31T09:00:00Z","last_failed_at":"2026-08-31T09:00:00Z","policy_version":"student-mastery-v1"}]
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	got, err := client.GetLearnerOverview(context.Background(), studentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, got.Onboarding)
	require.Equal(t, "backend", got.Onboarding.DirectionCode)
	require.Len(t, got.RecentMastery, 1)
	require.Equal(t, "go.interfaces", got.RecentMastery[0].Target.Key)
}

func TestClientLearnerOverviewAcceptsOwnerPathLifecycleAndRejectsUnknownFields(t *testing.T) {
	const studentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	for _, extra := range []string{"", `,"unknown_owner_field":true`} {
		t.Run(extra, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
				w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"student_id":"` + studentID + `","version":"student-learner-overview-v2","learning_path":{"id":"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222","student_id":"` + studentID + `","course_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","goal_code":"go.backend","curriculum_revision":"revision","course_fingerprint":"revision","policy_version":"student-learning-path-v1","planner_policy_version":"planner-v1","reason_code":"initial","reason_summary":"Initial path","status":"ACTIVE","is_primary":true,"is_selected":true,"version":1,"items":[{"reference_type":"lesson","reference_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","position":0,"status":"READY","targets":[],"reason_code":"initial"}],"created_at":"2026-10-03T00:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-10-03T00:00:00Z"` + extra + `}}`))
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			got, err := client.GetLearnerOverview(context.Background(), studentID)
			if extra != "" {
				require.Error(t, err)
				return
			}
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NotNil(t, got.LearningPath)
			require.Equal(t, "ACTIVE", got.LearningPath.Status)
			require.True(t, got.LearningPath.IsPrimary)
			require.True(t, got.LearningPath.IsSelected)
		})
	}
}

func TestClientGetsAndUpdatesLearningSessionMetrics(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	sessionID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	analyticsID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	requests := 0
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		requests++
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/students/"+studentID+"/learning-sessions/"+sessionID+map[bool]string{true: "/metrics", false: ""}[r.Method == http.MethodPut], r.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "internal-token", r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		version := 2
		if r.Method == http.MethodPut {
			var body map[string]any
			require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body))
			require.Equal(t, float64(1), body["expected_version"])
			require.Equal(t, float64(5), body["code_run_count"])
			version = 2
		}
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{
			"id":"` + sessionID + `","student_id":"` + studentID + `","goal":"Practice",
			"analytics_session_id":"` + analyticsID + `","active_learning_seconds":1200,
			"lesson_count":1,"task_count":2,"question_count":3,"selected_explanation_count":4,
			"code_run_count":5,"failure_count":2,"passed_test_count":3,"hint_count":1,
			"teacher_intervention_count":1,"stuck_signal_count":1,"version":` + fmt.Sprint(version) + `,
			"schema_version":"student-learning-session-v1","started_at":"2026-08-31T10:00:00Z",
			"ended_at":"2026-08-31T10:30:00Z","updated_at":"2026-08-31T10:31:00Z"
		}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	session, err := client.GetLearningSession(context.Background(), studentID, sessionID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 5, session.CodeRunCount)
	session.Version = 1
	analytics := domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary{
		AnalyticsSessionID: analyticsID, StudentID: studentID, ActiveLearningSeconds: 1200,
		LessonCount: 1, TaskCount: 2, QuestionCount: 3, SelectedExplanationCount: 4,
		CodeRunCount: 5, FailureCount: 2, PassedTestCount: 3, HintCount: 1,
		TeacherInterventionCount: 1, StuckSignalCount: 1,
	}
	updated, err := client.ApplyLearningSessionMetrics(context.Background(), studentID, sessionID, 1, analytics)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, int64(2), updated.Version)
	require.Equal(t, 2, requests)
}

func TestClientMapsNotFoundAndDependencyFailures(t *testing.T) {
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		status int
		want   error
	}{
		{name: "missing action", status: http.StatusNotFound, want: domain.ErrStudentContextNotFound},
		{name: "unauthorized dependency", status: http.StatusUnauthorized, want: domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable},
		{name: "student unavailable", status: http.StatusServiceUnavailable, want: domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
				w.WriteHeader(testCase.status)
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			_, err := client.GetLearningActionContext(
				context.Background(),
				"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
				"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
			)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, testCase.want)
		})
	}
}

func TestClientFailsClosedOnMalformedResponse(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"items":[],"unexpected":true}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := studenthttp.Client{
		BaseURL:       server.URL,
		InternalToken: "internal-token",
		HTTPClient:    &http.Client{Timeout: time.Second},
	}

	_, err := client.GetTargetMastery(
		context.Background(),
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		[]domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors"}},
	)
	require.True(t, errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable), "error=%v", err)
}

func TestClientFailsClosedOnOversizedResponse(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"items":[]}`+strings.Repeat(" ", 2<<20))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	_, err := client.GetTargetMastery(
		context.Background(),
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		[]domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.errors"}},
	)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable)
}

func TestClientRequiresOutboundInternalToken(t *testing.T) {
	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: "http://student.internal"}
	_, err := client.GetLearningActionContext(
		context.Background(),
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
		"22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
	)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable)
}

func TestClientTeacherOnboardingUsesDedicatedTokenAndExactCommands(t *testing.T) {
	studentID, key := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	now := "2026-09-05T08:00:00Z"
	calls := 0
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		calls++
		require.Equal(t, "teacher-token", r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/v1/teacher/students/"+studentID+"/onboarding/draft", strings.TrimSuffix(r.URL.Path, "/finalize"))
		switch r.Method {
		case http.MethodGet:
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"schema":"teacher-student-onboarding-state.v1","draft":{"schema":"student-onboarding-draft.v1","student_id":"`+studentID+`","status":"DRAFT","version":0},"profile_version":0}`)
		case http.MethodPut:
			require.Equal(t, key, r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"))
			var body map[string]json.RawMessage
			require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body))
			require.Len(t, body, 11)
			require.Equal(t, `null`, string(body["goal_text"]))
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"schema":"student-onboarding-draft.v1","student_id":"`+studentID+`","status":"DRAFT","direction_code":"backend","version":1,"created_at":"`+now+`","updated_at":"`+now+`"}`)
		case http.MethodPost:
			require.Equal(t, key, r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"))
			var body map[string]json.RawMessage
			require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body))
			require.Len(t, body, 3)
			_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `{"schema":"student-onboarding-finalize-result.v1","draft":{"schema":"student-onboarding-draft.v1","student_id":"`+studentID+`","status":"COMPLETED","version":2,"completed_profile_version":1,"created_at":"`+now+`","updated_at":"`+now+`","completed_at":"`+now+`"},"profile":{"student_id":"`+studentID+`","direction_code":"backend","self_assessed_experience":"new","known_stacks":[],"desired_stacks":["go"],"goal_code":"first_job","preferred_language":"ru","weekly_minutes":300,"preferred_pace":"balanced","profile_version":"student-onboarding-v1","version":1,"created_at":"`+now+`","updated_at":"`+now+`"}}`)
		default:
			t.Fatalf("unexpected method %s", r.Method)
		}
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "legacy-token", LearningWorkspaceToken: "teacher-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	state, err := client.GetTeacherOnboardingState(context.Background(), studentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Zero(t, state.Draft.Version)
	direction := "backend"
	draft, err := client.ReplaceTeacherOnboardingDraft(context.Background(), studentID, key, 0, domain.StudentOnboardingAnswers{DirectionCode: &direction})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, int64(1), draft.Version)
	finalized, err := client.FinalizeTeacherOnboardingDraft(context.Background(), studentID, key, 1, 0)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.StudentOnboardingDraftCompleted, finalized.Draft.Status)
	require.Equal(t, int64(1), finalized.Profile.Version)
	require.Equal(t, 3, calls)
}

func TestClientTeacherOnboardingRejectsUnknownResponseAndMapsConflict(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name   string
		status int
		body   string
	}{{"unknown", http.StatusOK, `{"schema":"teacher-student-onboarding-state.v1","draft":{"schema":"student-onboarding-draft.v1","student_id":"` + studentID + `","status":"DRAFT","version":0},"profile_version":0,"answers":{}}`}, {"conflict", http.StatusConflict, `{"error":"conflict"}`}} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
				w.WriteHeader(testCase.status)
				_, _ = io.WriteString(w, testCase.body)
			}))
			defer server.Close()
			client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, LearningWorkspaceToken: "teacher-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
			_, err := client.GetTeacherOnboardingState(context.Background(), studentID)
			if testCase.status == http.StatusConflict {
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict)
			} else {
				require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable)
			}
		})
	}
}
